items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a tune to write – that I wanted to write for a Bill Perkins album

ctx.x: Johnny, I’m just gonna run a list of your tunes by you in no particular order and some of them we’ve already discussed but any comments that come to mind fire away. “Just a Child.”
“Just a Child,” I had a tune to write – that I wanted to write for a Bill Perkins album and I’d wanted to write a song of that kind and that's what I wrote at that time.
That's one of your earliest songs really isn’t it?
